headline: Delegates Convene in Shanghai to Found Chinese Communist Party
dispatch: A small group of delegates gathered in a private house in the French Concession district of Shanghai on July 23, 1921, to open the first National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party. Thirteen representatives attended, drawing together Marxist study groups from across the country. The congress would formally establish the party that would, within three decades, govern the world's most populous nation.
answer: Chinese Communist Party holds its founding congress, 1921
